title: BlackRoad Product
description: Canonical record for one of the 27 BlackRoad OS products. This registry is the single source of truth; index.html is generated from it via scripts/sync-products.mjs.

id.description: Stable lowercase identifier used by the UI.

status.description: Honest build status. No fake 'done' without receipts.

meaning.description: What the product means / is for.

does.description: Capabilities. For PLANNED products these are intent, not promises.

agents.description: Primary agents wired to this product.

receipts.description: Receipt event names this product emits.

boundary.description: Optional scope boundary vs adjacent products.

primary_handoff.description: Optional: products this hands context off to.

core_promise.description: Optional core promise statement that defines the product's value.
